content: implementer view (SPEC §8.1) is a pure projection: renderImplementerView(plot, events) filters to {decision_made, question_posed, question_answered, artifact_produced, note}, slices the last 20 in original (chronological) order, and keeps attachments where role ∈ {tracks, implements, informs, reference}. PlotHandle.view('implementer') does the IO (read + events) and delegates to the pure function, so callers can render the view off any in-memory Plot without touching the file system.
